title: Affine symmetric Proj twist comparison with chart compatibility
statement: For every scheme S and quasi-coherent module E on S, there exists a TautologicalQuotient D E such that for every inclusion U <= V of affine opens there is an isomorphism from the pullback of the degree-one twist over V to the degree-one twist over U, and this isomorphism carries the chart of D over V to the chart of D over U through the canonical pullback composition comparison.

proof.text: Obtain a glued module L, its affine twist charts, and its normalized section map sigma. Take the quotient to be the tensor-pullback adjoint of sigma.

Prove degree-one standard opens cover each symmetric Proj by the symmetric algebra induction principle: if all degree-one generators lie in a prime, the quotient map factors through degree zero, so the irrelevant ideal lies in that prime. Apply the existing invertibility theorem for twists, transport along chart and boundary-pullback comparisons, and descend rank-one local freeness across the relative-Proj open cover.
Apply epimorphy from normalized sections. The adjunction inverse identity supplies the generator field of TautologicalQuotient, giving D.

For an affine inclusion, pull back D.chart V, invert it, then compose with the pullback-composition comparison, the equality of chart maps into relative Proj, and D.chart U. The required chart equation is precisely cancellation of an isomorphism with its inverse.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_comparison_with_chart_compatibility
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E,
      ∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V),
        Nonempty (AffineComparison E D U V h)
